trialEmails.subject: Your Pro trial ends on November 21
trialEmails.text:

After that, Pro costs $15/month (in US dollars, plus any sales tax or VAT where you live) until you cancel. If you'd like to keep Pro, there's nothing to do.

If you don't want to continue, you can cancel anytime before then from your account page, and you won't be charged anything more.

checkinEmails.subject: Your one-minute November check-in
checkinEmails.text:
One minute for November? Three quick questions, by voice or text. Skip any you like.

- What did you ship or improve? A feature, a fix, a process, a deal.
- Any numbers? Users, %, money, time saved. Rough is fine.
- Anything you learned or led? A skill, a tool, a person you helped.

Nothing new this month? That's one tap on the page.

Your notes stay free on every plan. When you look for your next job, Pro turns them into resume lines that quote your own facts.

Write my check-in: https://otto.test/c?a=1&b=2

processorNotice.subject: Dodo Payments takes live payments for Otto Sensei from December 1
processorNotice.text:
A short notice about payments: Dodo Payments now handles checkout for Otto Sensei in place of Paddle, and takes live payments from December 1, 2026.

Dodo Payments is our online reseller and merchant of record. It takes the payment when you buy a plan, and handles receipts, sales tax or VAT, refunds and billing support.

When you start a checkout, we send Dodo Payments your account email, our random id for your account and the plan you pick, the same details Paddle used to get. Dodo Payments handles your payment details under its own privacy policy.

There's nothing you need to do. Everything you've made in Otto Sensei stays as it is, and our prices don't change.

We've updated our terms, privacy policy and refund page to match:
Terms: https://otto.test/terms
Privacy policy: https://otto.test/privacy
Refunds: https://otto.test/refunds

Questions? Email hello@ottosensei.com.

Otto, from Otto Sensei

--
You're getting this because you have a Otto Sensei account. It's a one-time notice about a change to our terms and privacy policy, so it comes even if other emails are off.
